plainText:
KAORI. (born February 28, 1976) is a Japanese voice actress for .

==Biography==
KAORI. was born in , Japan. She had used the stage name Midori Kawana (Japanese: 川菜翠 Kawana Midori) until December 1999; she had used the name Akiko Kawana (Japanese: 川菜明子 Kawana Akiko) prior. In , she is credited as Kaori Suzuki (Japanese: 鈴木カオリ Suzuki Kaori).

KAORI.'s most prominent role in is . She played that character until the end of , when May left the series. She returned to voicing May briefly during Pokémon the Series: Diamond and Pearl. In May 2012, KAORI. revealed in a blog post that she had been diagnosed with a severe health condition affecting her larynx known as , severely impairing her ability to speak. As a result, neither May nor Max have made any further appearances in Pokémon the Series following Pokémon: The Series: Diamond and Pearl except in either flashbacks or brief, non-speaking cameos.

She was a member and singer of the band Spunky Strider until it disbanded in 2014.
